claims.text: Meningitis = the MC reason for an emergent LP.
claims.quote: meningitis: MC reason for emergent LP - bacterial + aseptic

claims.text: Don't delay abx when meningitis = sus.

claims.quote: CT before LP (IDSA 2004) when ANY: immunocompromised (HIV - chronic steroids - transplant)

claims.text: Also CT first for known CNS dz, a new sz w.in a wk, papilledema, AMS or a focal deficit.
claims.quote: CNS dz (mass - stroke - focal infection) - new-onset seizure w.in 1 wk - papilledema - AMS - focal neuro deficit

claims.text: Absolute contraindications: infected skin @ the site, or a space-occupying lesion on CT.
claims.quote: absolute: infected skin at puncture site - abnormal CT (space-occupying lesion)

claims.text: Relative: raised ICP, ↓PLT or ↑INR, brain abscess, anticoag.
claims.quote: relative: ↑ICP (meningitis - IIH) - thrombocytopenia/elevated INR - brain abscess - anticoagulants (Coumadin - Eliquis)

claims.text: US landmarks are easiest to see in young children (linear probe).
claims.quote: probe: linear high-freq (peds/non-obese) vs curvilinear (obese/deep) - ligamentum flavum/dura/subarachnoid visible (easiest in young children)
